basics.name: Wilson Espina
basics.label: Senior Frontend Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Frontend Engineer with 8+ years building user-facing React and TypeScript products, including high-scale web and Connected TV platforms used by millions. I lead delivery from discovery through production release, with a strong focus on maintainable architecture, performance, accessibility, and safe frequent deployments. I work closely with product, design, QA, and backend teams in Agile environments, contribute to planning and estimation, champion test automation, and mentor engineers to raise team capability.

experienceAreas.name: Project Work
points: Owned delivery of React TypeScript features for New Zealand's National Ticketing Solution, integrating UI components with a backend-for-frontend (BFF) layer to ship accessible user journeys safely into production.
Collaborated daily with product stakeholders, UX/UI designers, QA, and backend engineers to refine requirements, estimate delivery scope, and prioritise work across sprint cycles.
Built clean, reusable, and accessible React components to consume headless Contentful CMS content, improving maintainability and enabling faster iteration by content teams.
Implemented Auth0 integration for secure user sign-up and access control, strengthening production reliability and reducing onboarding friction.

experienceAreas.name: Delivering to deadlines
points: Quickly adapted to new technologies while working with New Zealand’s largest company, Fonterra, delivering interactive frontend solutions within tight timelines.
Improved team productivity by introducing faster Vite-based workflows and pragmatic UI implementation patterns to shorten feedback loops and support frequent releases.

experienceAreas.name: Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO)
points: Led frontend implementation of A/B experiments to optimise user journeys, improve conversion, and contribute directly to measurable revenue outcomes.
Implemented bespoke Optimizely experimentation solutions and collaborated with QA, analysts, and product stakeholders to deliver robust releases and clear experiment learnings.

experienceAreas.name: Process Improvement
points: Drove improvements in team efficiency by refining Agile ceremonies, improving estimation quality, and automating manual workflows through continuous feedback.

experienceAreas.name: Project Work
points: Owned end-to-end frontend delivery for Kiwibank, a major New Zealand retail bank, building scalable, maintainable React TypeScript components and collaborating with backend engineers, UX/UI designers, and business analysts to align technical solutions with business goals.
Delivered robust technical solutions within strict time and budget constraints for social justice sector clients, balancing competing priorities while maintaining quality and reliability.
Advocated for the latest CSS best practices and tooling within projects, resulting in reduced bundled sizes and increased maintainability.
Led frontend development for a Wagtail CMS-driven blog for the Kiwibank website, integrating Elastic Search UI React components and maintaining accessibility and performance best practices.

experienceAreas.name: ITVX Streaming Platform
points: Led technical delivery of complex Connected TV features for ITV Hub/ITVX across web and Samsung CTV platforms, building responsive, fluid, data-driven user experiences at broadcast scale.
Pioneered adoption of an internal GraphQL API by optimising queries and dynamic layout composition, improving data flow and rendering performance for large-screen interfaces.
Coordinated engineers to deliver React TypeScript components across CTV and web applications, shaping technical direction, reviewing architecture decisions, and mentoring junior developers.
Developed clean, type-safe components within an Atomic Design System, improving maintainability, reliability, and consistency across multiple device experiences.

experienceAreas.name: Mentoring
points: Facilitated and delivered technical GraphQL workshops for frontend engineers, helping teams adopt new patterns and improve engineering quality.
Provided in-depth mentorship through pairing, constructive code reviews, and technical guidance, supporting engineers to improve their craft and delivery impact.

experienceAreas.name: General Skills
points: Championed a shift-left testing approach using Cypress and React Testing Library, improving release confidence, debugging efficiency, and feedback speed.
Optimised DOM rendering in a CTV application, resolving performance bottlenecks on low-powered devices and improving live user experience.
Implemented subtitle integration for Samsung CTV devices on ITV Hub, improving accessibility and playback experience for large-screen audiences.
Built new ITV Hub CTV features in vanilla JavaScript using object-oriented patterns, delivering reliable interactivity on constrained smart TV environments.

experienceAreas.name: Mentoring

Collaborated with the UX/UI team to realise customer journeys through the company's AngularJS web application, ensuring a cohesive and intuitive user experience.

Completed an individual project that utilised React, Node, and Express to connect to the Strava and Google Maps APIs, resulting in a Strava run patterns application.
